verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence (gh-13) touts 'No API key management - just sign in with your Google account' as a benefit, implying account login is the primary/preferred auth flow rather than confirming a fully supported API-key alternative. No community or documentation evidence in the pack confirms a straightforward API-key-only auth path, and several community comments (comm-2, comm-3, comm-19) highlight confusion around Google's fragmented billing/auth options rather than a clean API-key mode.
